raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL` is documented as *"Interval (seconds) at which to empty **the device** cache; set this if memory accumulates over a long serving period."* On a multi-rank deployment it only ever emptied rank 0's cache, so every other rank kept accumulating until the process OOMed. That is #12344 ("`SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL` with `tp=2` clears only the first video card, the second one overflows"). The issue was closed as inactive and the code is unchanged on `main`, so the bug is still present.

Root cause: the interval reclaim lived in `IdleSleeper.maybe_sleep()`, and an `IdleSleeper` can only be built on the rank that owns the tokenizer/rpc sockets — `init_idle_sleeper` gates on `pp_rank == 0 and attn_tp_rank == 0 and attn_cp_rank == 0`, because `ipc_channels.recv_from_tokenizer` / `recv_from_rpc` are the poller's input and are `None` elsewhere. The gate itself is not removable: parking needs those sockets. But the caching allocator is **per process**, so reclaiming it from that one rank leaves the other ranks' cached blocks pinned for the life of the process.

Measured on a TP4 ROCm deployment (4x MI308X) serving GLM-5.3-Flash with `--sleep-on-idle` and `SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL=600`, some hours after the last request:

| device | free VRAM |
|---|---|
| GPU 0 (rank 0, has the `IdleSleeper`) | 49,276 MiB |
| GPU 1 / 2 / 3 | 15,728 / 15,758 / 15,856 MiB |

The three non-rank-0 devices were each sitting on roughly 33 GiB of cached-but-free blocks. A single `POST /flush_cache` then released 33,826 MiB on *each* of GPU 1/2/3 (GPU 0 unchanged) — so the per-rank `empty_cache()` itself works fine; only its trigger was rank-gated.

## Modifications

- `Scheduler.on_idle()` runs on **every** rank (both `event_loop_normal` and `event_loop_overlap` call it when there is no batch) and now calls the new `Scheduler.maybe_empty_cache_on_idle()`, which applies `SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL` to the local device.
- `IdleSleeper` / `RustServerIdleSleeper` go back to being parking primitives: they keep polling / waiting, and no longer own the interval or the `empty_cache()`.
- New CPU-only unit test, `test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_idle_empty_cache.py`, building a bare `Scheduler` with `idle_sleeper = None` (i.e. what every rank but the socket owner looks like).

The env var's default (`-1`) still disables the whole thing, and the reclaim stays gated on the rank actually being idle, so it never fires while a batch is in flight.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A — no model forward or kernel code is touched.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A. With `SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL` unset (the default) this is a no-op: `maybe_empty_cache_on_idle()` returns before doing any work. When it is set, the number of `empty_cache()` calls per rank is unchanged from before (at most one per interval, and only while the rank is fully idle) — the only difference is *which* ranks make them.

## Test evidence

The new cases fail on the pre-fix code and pass after it, which is the regression being guarded:

```
# before the fix
Ran 3 tests ... FAILED (errors=2)
  test_idle_reclaims_on_a_rank_without_an_idle_sleeper  -> AssertionError: 0 != 1
  test_reclaims_at_most_once_per_interval               -> AssertionError: 0 != 1
  test_disabled_interval_never_reclaims                 -> ok (negative branch, unaffected)

# after the fix
Ran 3 tests ... OK
```

## Checklist
- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). — no doc change needed: `environment_variables.mdx` already describes the intended per-device behavior, which this makes true.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). — N/A, see above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

**End-to-end A/B verification of this PR's exact `on_idle()` implementation** (not just the design — the two patched files were bind-mounted over the in-container source, byte-equivalent to this PR's diff):

- machine: amd-04, 8× MI308X (gfx942); isolated instance on GPU 4–7 (production on GPU 0–3 untouched), TP4, `--sleep-on-idle`, `SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL=60`
- image: `extrotec/glm53flash-mi308x-tp4:v519-merged-20260917-tuned3` (in-container sglang `832ec39cc0`, an ancestor of `main`)
- workload: 80 requests = 40 log-spaced prompt lengths (300–50k chars → 165–30,800 tokens) × 2 rounds (×1.12 offset), concurrency 8, all 200 OK
- sampling: `amd-smi metric --mem-usage` per-device `free_vram` (MiB)

| | gpu4 (rank0) | gpu5 | gpu6 | gpu7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Patched** T0 (idle baseline) | 50,338 | 50,633 | 50,649 | 50,697 |
| **Patched** T1 (load just finished) | 45,175 | 45,454 | 45,486 | 45,582 |
| **Patched** T2 (140 s idle later) | 49,299 | 49,578 | 49,610 | 49,706 |
| Δ(T2−T1) | **+4,124** | **+4,124** | **+4,124** | **+4,124** |
| **Unpatched** T0 | 50,338 | 50,633 | 50,649 | 50,697 |
| **Unpatched** T1 | 41,947 | 42,300 | 42,332 | 42,428 |
| **Unpatched** T2 | 49,287 | 42,300 | 42,332 | 42,428 |
| Δ(T2−T1) | **+7,340** | **0** | **0** | **0** |

Readings:

1. The **unpatched control reproduces #12344 exactly**: after 140 s idle only rank 0's device gave memory back; the other three ranks sat on ~8 GB of cached-but-free blocks with Δ = 0.
2. With this PR, all four ranks reclaim symmetrically (+4,124 MiB each) and return to the T0 steady state — the interval-gated reclaim now covers every rank.
3. The control also rules out "some other all-rank `empty_cache()` event did it": in the control the non-zero ranks were *not* reclaimed, so the patched group's symmetric reclaim is caused by this change, not by an incidental event.

The new unit tests also pass locally on this branch: `3 passed` (`test/registered/unit/managers/test_scheduler_idle_empty_cache.py`).

files.patch:
@@ -534,6 +534,7 @@ def __init__(
 
         # Init inter-process communication
         self.init_ipc_channels(port_args)
+        self._last_idle_empty_cache_time = time.monotonic()
         self.init_idle_sleeper()
 
         # Init PD-multiplexing context
@@ -4998,6 +4999,9 @@ def on_idle(self):
             self.load_inquirer.get_loads, force=True, snapshot=snapshot
         )
 
+        # Per-rank: the caching allocator is per process, not shared across ranks.
+        self.maybe_empty_cache_on_idle()
+
         # sleep until next event
         self.maybe_sleep_on_idle()
         self.metrics_reporter.record_scheduler_idle()
@@ -5880,6 +5884,17 @@ def close_session(self, recv_req: CloseSessionReqInput):
         ):
             self.session_controller.close(recv_req)
 
+    def maybe_empty_cache_on_idle(self) -> None:
+        """Reclaim this rank's cached allocator blocks once the interval elapses."""
+        interval = envs.SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL.get()
+        if interval <= 0:
+            return
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        if now - self._last_idle_empty_cache_time < interval:
+            return
+        self._last_idle_empty_cache_time = now
+        current_platform.empty_cache()
+
     def maybe_sleep_on_idle(self):
         if self.idle_sleeper is not None:
             self.idle_sleeper.maybe_sleep()

@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+"""Idle cache reclamation must run on every rank, not only the socket owner.
+
+SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL reclaims cached allocator blocks while the server
+is idle; gating that on the rank that owns the tokenizer/rpc sockets leaves the
+other ranks' cached blocks pinned until the process OOMs. CPU-only: builds a
+bare Scheduler with mocked collaborators, like test_scheduler_on_idle_load.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=8, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_EMPTY_CACHE = "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler.current_platform.empty_cache"
+_MONOTONIC = "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler.time.monotonic"
+
+
+class TestOnIdleEmptyCache(CustomTestCase):
+    def _idle_scheduler(self) -> Scheduler:
+        s = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+        s.scheduler_stage_metrics = MagicMock()
+        s.enable_hicache_storage = False
+        s.enable_unified_memory = False
+        s.enable_hisparse = False
+        s.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.NULL
+        s.idle_sleeper = None  # every rank except the one owning the ipc sockets
+        s._last_idle_empty_cache_time = 0.0
+        s.maybe_send_health_check_signal = MagicMock()
+        s.is_fully_idle = MagicMock(return_value=True)
+        s.publish_load_snapshot = MagicMock(return_value=None)
+        s.load_publisher = MagicMock()
+        s.load_inquirer = MagicMock()
+        s.metrics_reporter = MagicMock()
+        s.kv_events_publisher = MagicMock()
+        s.new_token_ratio_tracker = MagicMock()
+        s.pool_stats_observer = MagicMock()
+        s.token_to_kv_pool_allocator = MagicMock()
+        s.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.verify_byte_accounting.return_value = []
+        s.invariant_checker = MagicMock()
+        s.invariant_checker._check_all_pools.return_value = (False, [])
+        return s
+
+    def test_idle_reclaims_on_a_rank_without_an_idle_sleeper(self):
+        s = self._idle_scheduler()
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL.override(600),
+            patch(_EMPTY_CACHE) as empty_cache,
+            patch(_MONOTONIC, return_value=1000.0),
+        ):
+            s.on_idle()
+        self.assertEqual(empty_cache.call_count, 1)
+
+    def test_disabled_interval_never_reclaims(self):
+        s = self._idle_scheduler()
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL.override(-1),
+            patch(_EMPTY_CACHE) as empty_cache,
+            patch(_MONOTONIC, return_value=1e9),
+        ):
+            s.on_idle()
+        self.assertEqual(empty_cache.call_count, 0)
+
+    def test_reclaims_at_most_once_per_interval(self):
+        s = self._idle_scheduler()
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL.override(600),
+            patch(_EMPTY_CACHE) as empty_cache,
+            patch(_MONOTONIC) as monotonic,
+        ):
+            monotonic.return_value = 1000.0
+            s.on_idle()
+            self.assertEqual(empty_cache.call_count, 1)
+
+            monotonic.return_value = 1599.0  # still inside the interval
+            s.on_idle()
+            self.assertEqual(empty_cache.call_count, 1)
+
+            monotonic.return_value = 1601.0
+            s.on_idle()
+            self.assertEqual(empty_cache.call_count, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(s._last_idle_empty_cache_time, 1601.0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
